PolarHacks 2026

PolarHacks is a 36-hour hackathon focused on climate resilience tools.

Important Dates

  • Hacking begins: March 14, 2026 at 9:00 AM MST
  • Submission deadline: March 15, 2026 at 9:00 PM MST. Late submissions will not be judged.

Eligibility

Teams of 1 to 4 members. All participants must be 18 or older or have guardian consent.

All projects must be started during the hackathon. Pre-existing code beyond open-source libraries is not permitted and will result in disqualification.

Submission Requirements

  • Submit your project on Devpost before the deadline.
  • Include a demo video no longer than 3 minutes uploaded to YouTube or Vimeo.
  • Provide a link to a public GitHub repository containing your source code.
  • Your repository must include a README with setup instructions.

Judging Criteria

CriterionWeight
Technical Complexity30%
Impact on Climate Resilience25%
Originality20%
Design and User Experience15%
Presentation10%

Prizes

  • Grand Prize: $5,000
  • Best Use of Open Climate Data API: $1,500
  • Best Beginner Hack: $500

Sponsor Rules

To be eligible for Best Use of Open Climate Data API, projects must use the Open Climate Data API as a core feature.

Code of Conduct

Harassment of any kind is prohibited and may result in removal from the event.
